credit_state.why: kit credit needs phase in DONE_FOR_COMPLETION AND qc_ok AND (remote proof OR delivery proof). Delivery proof is true once delivery_sha matches; qc_ok is false because there is no independent PASS receipt at qc/GRAPHIFY-DISPOSITION.<digest>.json yet. No chain may QC its own build, so a PASS receipt must come from an independent Opus QC lane.
credit_state.residual_for_a_later_lane: qc/<unit>.<digest>.json needs non-empty head and base strings (receipt_problem); this row keeps head/base null on purpose so it adds no false BUILD RECONCILIATION note. An Opus QC lane that writes the receipt must also record head/base tokens (HYGIENE-W77S precedent: registry-8of8), which will then surface one BUILD RECONCILIATION note naming it - a cost recorded here, not hidden.
